Classes.Name: Win32_OperatingSystem
Classes.Description: The operating system: version, build, edition, architecture, language.

Properties.Name: Version
Properties.Description: Version of the kernel, as text: 10.0.26100 for example; compare it with LIKE.

Properties.Name: BuildNumber
Properties.Description: Build number, as text: compare five-digit builds only.

Properties.Name: Caption
Properties.Description: Name of the operating system, in its language.

Properties.Name: OSArchitecture
Properties.Description: 64-bit or 32-bit, in the language of the system: compare it with LIKE '64%'.

Properties.Name: OSLanguage
Properties.Description: Language of the installation (LCID), not the display language.

Classes.Name: Win32_ComputerSystem
Classes.Description: The computer: name, domain, role, manufacturer, model, type, memory.

Properties.Name: Domain
Properties.Description: DNS name of the domain (or the workgroup).

Properties.Name: PartOfDomain
Properties.Description: The computer is a member of a domain.

Properties.Name: TotalPhysicalMemory
Properties.Description: Memory, in bytes (a little below the memory installed).

Properties.Name: HypervisorPresent
Properties.Description: A hypervisor runs: a virtual machine, or a Hyper-V host (or VBS).

Classes.Name: Win32_Processor
Classes.Description: The processors.

Classes.Name: Win32_LogicalDisk
Classes.Description: The drives: their letter, type, size and free space.

Properties.Name: DeviceID
Properties.Description: Letter of the drive: C: for example.

Classes.Name: Win32_BIOS
Classes.Description: The firmware of the computer.

Classes.Name: Win32_SystemEnclosure
Classes.Description: The chassis of the computer.

Classes.Name: Win32_Battery
Classes.Description: The batteries: a laptop has one (a UPS can show as one).

Classes.Name: Win32_IP4RouteTable
Classes.Description: The IPv4 routes: the route of its own address tells the subnet of a computer.

Properties.Name: Mask
Properties.Description: Mask of the route: 255.255.255.255 for the address of the computer.

Properties.Name: NextHop
Properties.Description: Next hop: the gateway of the route 0.0.0.0.

Classes.Name: Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration
Classes.Description: The configuration of the network adapters (IPAddress is a list: it cannot be compared).

Properties.Name: DHCPEnabled
Properties.Description: The adapter gets its address by DHCP.

Classes.Name: Win32_TimeZone
Classes.Description: The time zone of the computer.

Properties.Name: Bias
Properties.Description: Offset from UTC, in minutes: 60 for Paris, -300 for New York.

Properties.Name: StandardName
Properties.Description: Name of the time zone, in the language of the system.

Classes.Name: Win32_LocalTime
Classes.Description: The local time when the GPOs are applied.

Classes.Name: Win32_Service
Classes.Description: The services of Windows.

Properties.Name: Name
Properties.Description: Name of the service: Spooler for example.

Classes.Name: Win32_QuickFixEngineering
Classes.Description: The updates installed (a cumulative update can hide older ones).

Properties.Name: HotFixID
Properties.Description: Number of the update: KB5001234 for example.

Classes.Name: Win32_InstalledWin32Program
Classes.Description: The programs installed, as Settings lists them: fast (Windows 10 and later clients).

Properties.Name: Version
Properties.Description: Version of the program, as text.

Classes.Name: Win32_Product
Classes.Description: The programs installed by Windows Installer (MSI).
Classes.Warning: Win32_Product checks and repairs every MSI program each time it is read, and is slow: prefer Win32_InstalledWin32Program.

Properties.Name: Version
Properties.Description: Version of the program, as text.

Classes.Name: Win32_OptionalFeature
Classes.Description: The optional features of Windows.

Properties.Name: Name
Properties.Description: Name of the feature: Microsoft-Hyper-V-All for example.

Classes.Name: Win32_ServerFeature
Classes.Description: The roles and features of Windows Server (servers only).

Properties.Name: ID
Properties.Description: Identifier of the role or feature.

Properties.Name: Name
Properties.Description: Name of the role or feature, in the language of the system.

Classes.Name: CIM_DataFile
Classes.Description: The files: give the full path in Name.
Classes.Warning: Query a file by its full Name only: a query by its folder or extension reads the whole disk.

Properties.Name: Name
Properties.Description: Full path of the file: C:\Windows\notepad.exe.

Properties.Name: Version
Properties.Description: Version of the file, as text.

Classes.Name: Win32_Directory
Classes.Description: The folders: give the full path in Name.

Properties.Name: Name
Properties.Description: Full path of the folder: C:\Program Files\Contoso.

Classes.Name: Win32_Environment
Classes.Description: The environment variables.

Classes.Name: Win32_DiskPartition
Classes.Description: The partitions of the disks.

Properties.Name: Type
Properties.Description: Type of the partition: GPT: System is the partition of an UEFI computer.

Classes.Name: Win32_Tpm
Classes.Description: The TPM of the computer (no instance without a TPM).

Properties.Name: SpecVersion
Properties.Description: Version of the TPM: 2.0, 0, 1.16 for example.

Classes.Name: Win32_EncryptableVolume
Classes.Description: The volumes BitLocker can encrypt.

Classes.Name: Win32_DeviceGuard
Classes.Description: Virtualization-based security (VBS) and code integrity.

Classes.Name: AntiVirusProduct
Classes.Description: The antivirus programs registered in the Security Center.
Classes.Warning: root\SecurityCenter2 does not exist on Windows Server: the query is False there.

Templates.Name: Workstations
Templates.Description: Windows clients, not servers.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE ProductType = 1

Templates.Name: Member servers
Templates.Description: Windows Server, domain controllers excepted.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE ProductType = 3

Templates.Name: Domain controllers
Templates.Description: The domain controllers of Windows Server.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE ProductType = 2

Templates.Name: Servers
Templates.Description: Windows Server, domain controllers included.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE ProductType <> 1

Templates.Name: All but domain controllers
Templates.Description: Workstations and member servers.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE ProductType <> 2

Templates.Name: Windows 11
Templates.Description: Every release of Windows 11.
Templates.Note: BuildNumber is a text: the comparison is right between builds of five digits, Version LIKE '10.0%' keeps the older systems out.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE Version LIKE '10.0%' AND BuildNumber >= '22000' AND ProductType = 1

Templates.Name: Windows 10
Templates.Description: Every release of Windows 10.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE Version LIKE '10.0%' AND BuildNumber < '22000' AND ProductType = 1

Templates.Name: A release of Windows 11
Templates.Description: One version of Windows 11, by its build.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE BuildNumber = '{Build}' AND ProductType = 1

Templates.Name: A version of Windows Server
Templates.Description: One version of Windows Server, by its build.
Templates.Note: Windows Server 2025 and Windows 11 24H2 share the build 26100: ProductType tells them apart.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE BuildNumber = '{Build}' AND ProductType <> 1

Templates.Name: Minimum build
Templates.Description: Windows 10, 11 or Server from a build on.
Templates.Note: BuildNumber is a text: give a build of five digits.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE Version LIKE '10.0%' AND BuildNumber >= '{Build}'

Templates.Name: Windows before Windows 10
Templates.Description: Windows 7, 8, 8.1, Server 2008 R2, 2012 and 2012 R2 (version 6.x).
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE Version LIKE '6.%'

Templates.Name: Edition of Windows
Templates.Description: One edition, by its SKU.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE OperatingSystemSKU = {Sku}

Templates.Name: Server Core
Templates.Description: Windows Server installed without the desktop experience.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE OperatingSystemSKU = 12 OR OperatingSystemSKU = 13 OR OperatingSystemSKU = 14 OR OperatingSystemSKU = 147 OR OperatingSystemSKU = 148

Templates.Name: 64-bit Windows
Templates.Description: The 64-bit operating systems.
Templates.Note: OSArchitecture is in the language of the system (64 bits, 64-Bit...): LIKE '64%' reads them all.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE OSArchitecture LIKE '64%'

Templates.Name: 32-bit Windows
Templates.Description: The 32-bit operating systems.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE OSArchitecture LIKE '32%'

Templates.Name: ARM64 processor
Templates.Description: The computers with an ARM64 processor.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Processor WHERE Architecture = 12

Templates.Name: Language of the installation
Templates.Description: The language Windows was installed in.
Templates.Note: OSLanguage is the language of the installation, not the display language a user chose.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OperatingSystem WHERE OSLanguage = {Language}

Templates.Name: Members of a domain
Templates.Description: The computers joined to a domain.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE PartOfDomain = TRUE

Templates.Name: Computers of a domain
Templates.Description: The members of one domain, by its DNS name.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Domain = '{Domain}'

Templates.Name: Name of the computer
Templates.Description: The computers whose name matches a pattern.
Templates.Note: % stands for any text and _ for one character: write [_] for an underscore.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Name LIKE '{Pattern}'

Templates.Name: PDC emulator
Templates.Description: The domain controller that holds the PDC emulator role.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE DomainRole = 5

Templates.Name: Laptops
Templates.Description: The mobile computers.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE PCSystemType = 2

Templates.Name: Desktops
Templates.Description: The desktop computers and workstations.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE PCSystemType = 1 OR PCSystemType = 3

Templates.Name: Computers with a battery
Templates.Description: The computers with a battery: laptops and tablets.
Templates.Note: A UPS connected by USB can show as a battery.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Battery

Templates.Name: Manufacturer
Templates.Description: The computers of one manufacturer.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer LIKE '{Manufacturer}%'

Templates.Name: Model
Templates.Description: The computers whose model holds a text.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Model LIKE '%{Model}%'

Templates.Name: Minimum memory
Templates.Description: The computers with at least this memory.
Templates.Note: TotalPhysicalMemory is a little below the memory installed: a GB counts here 1,000,000,000 bytes.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE TotalPhysicalMemory >= {Memory}

Templates.Name: Free space on a drive
Templates.Description: The computers with at least this free space on a drive.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_LogicalDisk WHERE DeviceID = '{Drive}' AND FreeSpace >= {Free}

Templates.Name: Minimum processor cores
Templates.Description: The computers whose processor has at least this number of cores.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Processor WHERE NumberOfCores >= {Cores}

Templates.Name: Maker of the processor
Templates.Description: Intel or AMD processors.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Processor WHERE Manufacturer = '{Vendor}'

Templates.Name: UEFI firmware
Templates.Description: The computers started in UEFI mode, by their EFI system partition.
Templates.Note: A heuristic: no WMI class tells the firmware mode or Secure Boot as a value; test it on your models.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_DiskPartition WHERE Type = 'GPT: System'

Templates.Name: Hypervisor present
Templates.Description: Virtual machines of any hypervisor.
Templates.Note: Also True on a physical Hyper-V host and with virtualization-based security.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE HypervisorPresent = TRUE

Templates.Name: Hyper-V or Azure virtual machines
Templates.Description: The virtual machines of Hyper-V and Azure.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer = 'Microsoft Corporation' AND Model = 'Virtual Machine'

Templates.Name: Azure virtual machines
Templates.Description: The virtual machines of Azure, by the asset tag of their chassis.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_SystemEnclosure WHERE SMBIOSAssetTag = '7783-7084-3265-9085-8269-3286-77'

Templates.Name: VMware virtual machines
Templates.Description: The virtual machines of VMware.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer LIKE 'VMware%'

Templates.Name: VirtualBox virtual machines
Templates.Description: The virtual machines of VirtualBox.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer = 'innotek GmbH' OR Model = 'VirtualBox'

Templates.Name: KVM, QEMU and Proxmox virtual machines
Templates.Description: The virtual machines of KVM and QEMU (Proxmox VE).
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer LIKE 'QEMU%'

Templates.Name: Nutanix AHV virtual machines
Templates.Description: The virtual machines of Nutanix AHV.
Templates.Note: The physical nodes of Nutanix also show Nutanix: Model AHV keeps them out.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer = 'Nutanix' AND Model = 'AHV'

Templates.Name: Xen virtual machines
Templates.Description: The virtual machines of Xen and XenServer.
Templates.Note: Values seen in the community: check them with the test on one of your virtual machines.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer LIKE 'Xen%'

Templates.Name: Amazon EC2 instances
Templates.Description: The instances of Amazon EC2 (Nitro).
Templates.Note: Values seen in the community: check them with the test on one of your virtual machines.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE Manufacturer LIKE 'Amazon EC2%'

Templates.Name: Physical computers
Templates.Description: Neither Hyper-V, VMware, VirtualBox nor QEMU virtual machines.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE NOT Model LIKE '%Virtual%' AND NOT Manufacturer LIKE 'VMware%' AND NOT Manufacturer LIKE 'QEMU%' AND NOT Manufacturer = 'innotek GmbH'

Templates.Name: TPM enabled
Templates.Description: The computers with an enabled TPM.
Templates.Note: The test needs an elevated session: the GPOs are evaluated by the system.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Tpm WHERE IsEnabled_InitialValue = TRUE

Templates.Name: TPM 2.0
Templates.Description: The computers with a TPM 2.0.
Templates.Note: The test needs an elevated session: the GPOs are evaluated by the system.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Tpm WHERE SpecVersion LIKE '2.0%'

Templates.Name: BitLocker protects a drive
Templates.Description: The computers whose drive BitLocker protects.
Templates.Note: The test needs an elevated session: the GPOs are evaluated by the system.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_EncryptableVolume WHERE DriveLetter = '{Drive}' AND ProtectionStatus = 1

Templates.Name: BitLocker does not protect a drive
Templates.Description: The computers whose drive is not protected yet: to apply a BitLocker GPO to them.
Templates.Note: The test needs an elevated session: the GPOs are evaluated by the system.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_EncryptableVolume WHERE DriveLetter = '{Drive}' AND ProtectionStatus = 0

Templates.Name: Virtualization-based security running
Templates.Description: The computers where VBS runs (Windows 10, Server 2016 and later).
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_DeviceGuard WHERE VirtualizationBasedSecurityStatus = 2

Templates.Name: Code integrity policy enforced
Templates.Description: The computers where an App Control policy is enforced.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_DeviceGuard WHERE CodeIntegrityPolicyEnforcementStatus = 2

Templates.Name: Antivirus registered
Templates.Description: The workstations where an antivirus program is registered in the Security Center.
Templates.Note: root\SecurityCenter2 does not exist on Windows Server: the query is False there.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM AntiVirusProduct WHERE displayName LIKE '%{Name}%'

Templates.Name: IP subnet
Templates.Description: The computers with an IPv4 address in a subnet, as a site.
Templates.Note: The route of its own address (mask 255.255.255.255) tells the address of a computer: IPAddress of the adapters is a list, which WQL cannot compare.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_IP4RouteTable WHERE Mask = '255.255.255.255' AND Destination LIKE '{Prefix}%'

Templates.Name: Default gateway
Templates.Description: The computers whose default route goes through a gateway.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_IP4RouteTable WHERE Destination = '0.0.0.0' AND NextHop = '{Gateway}'

Templates.Name: DNS suffix of a network adapter
Templates.Description: The computers with a network adapter in a DNS domain.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration WHERE IPEnabled = TRUE AND DNSDomain = '{Suffix}'

Templates.Name: Time zone
Templates.Description: The computers of a time zone, by its offset from UTC.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_TimeZone WHERE Bias = {Bias}

Templates.Name: Program installed
Templates.Description: The computers where a program is installed, as Settings lists it.
Templates.Note: Win32_InstalledWin32Program is fast but exists on clients only (Windows 10 and later).
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_InstalledWin32Program WHERE Name LIKE '%{Name}%'

Templates.Name: MSI program installed (slow)
Templates.Description: The computers where Windows Installer installed a program, servers included.
Templates.Note: Win32_Product checks and repairs every MSI program each time it is read, and is slow: prefer Win32_InstalledWin32Program.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Product WHERE Name LIKE '%{Name}%'

Templates.Name: Service installed
Templates.Description: The computers with a service, by its name.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Service WHERE Name = '{Service}'

Templates.Name: Service running
Templates.Description: The computers where a service runs.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Service WHERE Name = '{Service}' AND State = 'Running'

Templates.Name: Update installed
Templates.Description: The computers with an update, by its KB number.
Templates.Note: A cumulative update can hide the older updates it replaces.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_QuickFixEngineering WHERE HotFixID = '{HotFix}'

Templates.Name: Optional feature enabled
Templates.Description: The computers where an optional feature of Windows is enabled.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_OptionalFeature WHERE Name = '{Feature}' AND InstallState = 1

Templates.Name: Role of Windows Server installed
Templates.Description: The servers with a role or a feature.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ServerFeature WHERE ID = {Role}

Templates.Name: Environment variable
Templates.Description: The computers where a system variable has a value.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Environment WHERE Name = '{Variable}' AND VariableValue = '{Value}'

Templates.Name: File exists
Templates.Description: The computers where a file exists.
Templates.Note: Give the full path: the backslashes are doubled in the query.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM CIM_DataFile WHERE Name = '{Path}'

Templates.Name: Minimum version of a file
Templates.Description: The computers where a file has at least a version.
Templates.Note: Version is a text: compare versions with as many digits.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM CIM_DataFile WHERE Name = '{Path}' AND Version >= '{Version}'

Templates.Name: Folder exists
Templates.Description: The computers where a folder exists.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_Directory WHERE Name = '{Path}'

Templates.Name: Working days
Templates.Description: Monday to Friday, when the GPOs are applied.
Templates.Note: Evaluated at each refresh of the policies only.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_LocalTime WHERE DayOfWeek >= 1 AND DayOfWeek <= 5

Templates.Name: Hours of the day
Templates.Description: Between two hours, when the GPOs are applied.
Templates.Note: Evaluated at each refresh of the policies only.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_LocalTime WHERE Hour >= {From} AND Hour < {To}

Templates.Name: Normal boot
Templates.Description: The computers not started in safe mode.
Templates.Query: SELECT * FROM Win32_ComputerSystem WHERE BootupState = 'Normal boot'
